body:
LEAD DISPOSITION ON THE SEMANTIC-CHANNEL GAP: ACCEPT AS A P1/G4 CALIBRATION DEPENDENCY; NO D2 AMENDMENT.

Exact current-main evidence establishes that HashedNgramEmbedder and TfIdfEmbedder are lexical baselines, and that neither the ratified local ONNX provider module nor the remote transport module exists. This does not weaken the V7 source/time/evidence contract and does not reopen its exact candidate. It changes what later evidence may claim.

1. Hashed n-gram and TF-IDF remain valuable registered baseline arms. They cannot support a claim that non-lexical semantic source-to-recall matching has been validated.
2. Any P1 question whose answer depends on semantic similarity must bind an admitted non-lexical dense provider. A P1 court that answers only a mechanics or structural question may remain useful, but must say so and cannot be promoted as semantic-channel validation.
3. Every P1 and later G4 calibration artifact must bind the complete coordinate system: ProviderFingerprint; query and document GeometryIds plus the geometry-pair rule; semantic views/instructions; CostWeights; missingness and imputation; candidate-generator settings; HSMM configuration; corpus/protocol identity; and the calibration model. A change creates a new calibration problem. No floor is shared across lexical and dense geometries.
4. The eventual movie contrast registry retains separate transcript-only, visual-only, audio-only, full-fusion, and one-shot arms; within any arm, provider geometry and calibration identity are fixed before the untouched split. A positive audiovisual gain is not interpretable if the transcript baseline is a mislabeled lexical placeholder.
5. Local ONNX and credentialed remote transport are separate admission paths. A real dense provider does not inherently require an API key. No provider choice, credential request, dependency, runtime, source fetch, or movie adapter is authorized by this ruling.

Request to chief: bind this dependency when promoting the P1 integration parent and calibration court. The D2 V7 candidate remains byte-frozen and awaits only its named scout review plus chief governance reconciliation.
